notes.subject: ואין מבין
notes.rationale: 'and none understood (it)' — no one understood the vision (KJV/Geneva) vs Daniel himself did not understand (JPS) vs 'it was beyond understanding' (BSB); rendered 'mɔgɔ si tɛ a dɔn'.

notes.subject: נהייתי ונחליתי
notes.rationale: 'I became and was worn/weak' — two verbs of collapse rendered as one state 'balo-donbali' (sick-unable); the doubling is kept only in the compound.

notes.subject: ואשתומם
notes.rationale: Rare stem שׁתם — stunned, numb, appalled; rendered periphrastically 'hakili jira ka bɔ a nɔ na', losing the single stunned-verb picture.

translation: Ni ne, Daniyel (Daniel), ne kɛra balo-donbali ye don wɔɔrɛ; ne y'ilika, ne ye ⟨את⟩ masakɛ baara kɛ, ne ye ɲɛtaa la hakili jira ka bɔ a nɔ na — mɔgɔ si tɛ a dɔn.

tokens.gloss: ne ye … hakili jira ka bɔ a nɔ na
